t: AI Environmental Restoration: Reforestation Optimizer — Simple
name: AI Environmental Restoration: Reforestation Optimizer — Simple
title: AI Environmental Restoration: Reforestation Optimizer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] An optimizer that designs plantings for survival, not photo ops: it matches species to microsite, staggers planting by season, and spaces for canopy closure at year ten. The plan's success metric is living trees at year five, counted by survey.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Seedlings for 40 ha at 1,100/ha, 75% survival = 58667 seedlings. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Environmental Restoration & Planetary Health + AI-Powered Environmental Regeneration
real_world_basis: Ecological restoration planning with survival-based metrics is standard in serious reforestation programs.
signature_version: Signature version: the restoration Balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (intervention vs natural recovery) scored per site, with the 'universal regeneration' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: survey the microsite first, plant for year-five survival, and count living trees — not seedlings planted.
math_note: Seedlings for 40 ha at 1,100/ha, 75% survival: 58667 seedlings [verified]; Stand increment: r=0.3, N=8,000 of K=50,000: 2016 trees/yr [verified]

math_check.label: Stand increment: r=0.3, N=8,000 of K=50,000

safety: Fire safety: plantings include firebreaks and the plan accounts for burn risk — restoration must not manufacture fuel loads.
how_it_works: Site data feeds a species–microsite matcher; the optimizer lays out planting blocks and schedules; survival surveys close the loop. The demo recomputes seedlings needed per hectare and the logistic growth of the stand.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact

t: AI Environmental Restoration: Wetland Rebuilder — Simple
name: AI Environmental Restoration: Wetland Rebuilder — Simple
title: AI Environmental Restoration: Wetland Rebuilder — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A rebuilder that restores wetland hydrology before planting a single reed: it models the water budget, regrades to the target hydroperiod, and only then introduces vegetation. Wetlands are water first, plants second.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Water volume: 12,000 m2 at 0.4 m depth = 4800 m3. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Environmental Restoration & Planetary Health + AI-Powered Environmental Regeneration
real_world_basis: Hydrology-first wetland restoration is the professional standard.
signature_version: Signature version: the restoration Totality assessor — restored vs reference wetland function as a computed ratio, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: model the water first, regrade to the hydroperiod, then plant what the water supports.
math_note: Water volume: 12,000 m2 at 0.4 m depth: 4800 m3 [verified]; Monitoring archive: 5 years of daily 2 MB logs: 0.0035 TB [verified]

math_check.label: Water volume: 12,000 m2 at 0.4 m depth
Monitoring archive: 5 years of daily 2 MB logs

safety: Hydrology safety: never impound water without downstream review — restoration upstream must not flood downstream.
how_it_works: Topography and hydrology models set the regrade plan; earthworks restore the hydroperiod; vegetation follows the water. The demo recomputes the water volume for the target depth and the archive cost of the monitoring record.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
